name: Vienna International Airport

runway.v: two runways: 16/34, 3,600 m long and 45 m wide, and 11/29, 3,500 m long and 45 m wide
runway.quote: length 3,600 metres, width 45 metres, 2 shoulders 7.5 metres

hours.quote: 24 hours / no night curfew, but there is a limit of movements in accordance with the mediation agreement.

curfew.v: no night curfew; under the mediation agreement, movements in the night core period 23:30 to 05:30 are limited to 4,700 a year
curfew.quote: the number of aircraft movements during the night core period has been limited to 4,700 as of 2010

slots.v: fully coordinated airport (EU Regulation 95/93), slots via Slot Coordination Austria; GA/BA slot requests accepted at most 28 days ahead (night-flight guideline)
slots.quote: Slot requests for GA/BA flights are accepted maximum 28 days ahead of the planned operation

max_aircraft.v: EASA Code 4E; A380, Antonov 124 and Boeing 747-8 can operate
max_aircraft.quote: Certification: EASA Code 4E; A380, Antonov 124 and Boeing 747-8 OPS possible.

handling.v: the airport's own General Aviation Center (business and private jet terminal), plus a VIP Terminal

notes: AIP pages carry different dates; edition used is the AIRAC set published 02 OCT 2026 (next AIRAC 29 Oct 2026 not checked). Slot Coordination Austria states Vienna is fully coordinated: "which is fully coordinated according to EU-regulation 95/93". Night core period for slot purposes is 23:30-05:30 daily. Night limit is a mediation agreement, not a statutory ban.
